name: Troop markers
slug: Cave-floor game pieces Elrus calls toy soldiers until the table reads them as a landmark map.
description: Pieces scattered on the cave floor, made of black stone and ivory, or possibly dark metal or bronze. The shapes are knight-like cavalry, small etched dragons, pawns marked for rank or unit size, and flat poker-chip tokens in two matched varieties with roughly equal counts.

log.summary: One marker was removed from the table in the vision tied to the Raskina and is not in the room. Vecna's hunched eagle is a separate high-ranking piece, not one of the poker chips. Elrus treats the set as toy soldiers and sees no use for them without a map, until the table reads them as a landmark map.
